notes.title: Updates and Localization!
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross prepares for new languages!

Version 0.2.15

Bugfix
-Fixed loading screen crash from localization

Version 0.2.14

Graphics
-Drop shadows added to UI elements
-Shadows added to all characters

Hooty
-A new artifact available from plinko!
-Picks up the piece it lands on and makes it your next piece.

Helm Traders
-No longer give a free book instead of plinko if you have a powerful helm

The City
-Each house slot must now be unlocked by building a foundation
-House slots get more expensive with each purchase
-Only effects new saves

Localization
-Backend for translations added
-First draft spanish translations added
-Language Menu added to Title Screen

Bugfixes
-Volume decreased on Manticore attacks
-Input disabled during cut scene
-Grid input disabled when game is paused
-Hair disabled on several helmets
-Added mask to hair on several helmets
-Striker's Chest no longer spawns gray pieces

notes.title: New Year brings new content!
notes.notes:
The new year comes with new content, including new and updated NPCs!

[code]
Version 0.2.13

The Alignment Characters have had their items redistributed
    Chrono Man
    -Replaces Good Man
    -Gives Chrono Clock - stops enemy attacks for 5 turns (previously Order Book)
    -Chrono Mask - slows enemy attacks and piece drop speed (previously Order Mask and Chaos Mask)

    Order Man
    -Order Book now clears all gray pieces (previously Good Book)
    -Order Mask now gives bonus coins (previously Good Mask)

    Chaos Man
    -Chaos Book changes gray pieces to random colors (unchanged)
    -Chaos Mask now reduces play area and increases overall damage (previously Evil Mask)

    Good Man and Gear
    -Removed

    Evil Man and Gear
    -Removed

    Damien
    -Hint for good and evil replaced with hint for Chronomancer

Barry The Bomber
-Replaces Evil Man
-Drops three bombs immediately for free, or buy his bombs for 3 coins.

Sam The Swordsmith
-His sword now activates immediately

Dogman Enemy
-Barrels spawn higher up in the grid
-Lowered attack rate

MatchPaint Shield
-No longer triggers from gray pieces like acorns

Fragile Crystal Piece
-New Sprite

Asteroid Piece
-Changed sprite for the embedded piece

End Game
-Victory and Defeat animations updated

Tutorial
-Now gives bombs as the example artifact

Bugfixes
-The Tutorial now correctly starts
-Ninja Wrap Helmet works correctly with Axe Pieces
-Dagger Attack second piece now changes size and color correctly
-Steam Achievements no longer crash if Steam isn't loaded
-Load screen scales with screen height
[/code]

notes.title: Two new NPCs join Super Puzzle Cross
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.12, bringing a wide variety of changes, including two new NPCs!

[code]
Version 0.2.12

Carl the Color Knight
-Replaces Pat the Librarian
-Selects a color, either one of the favored colors of the zone, or one at random if there are no favored colors
-Provides one of several effects based on the selected color
-Either increase chance for piece color, or change color of one gear, or choose a free artifact of the selected color

Sam the Swordsmith
-Replaces Ben the Weakener
-Choose between dropping a sword immediately or buying a sword artifact
-Sam retains Ben's powerful item

Trident Artifact
-New artifact that gives 5 tridents
-Obtained through coin drops or Carl

Damien the Power Broker
-Added additional text to explain hints

Bill, Bob, Jeff, and Greg
-If you decline their powerful item, you still recieve their book as normal

Order Token
-No longer remains on the field while in effect
-Instead the animation will remain for the duration and the sound will replay at the end

Demon Enemy
-The Boss's color absorb now effects all dropped pieces like Pet and Armor pieces

Ninja Wrap Helmet
-Now effects all dropped pieces like Pet and Armor pieces
-Now effects pieces with capsule shaped match areas (axe pieces)

Mystic Cowl Helmet
-Now effects all dropped pieces like Pet and Armor pieces

Egg Piece
-No longer changes color of pieces if the Egg Piece is gray

Skull Mask
-Now a powerful item from an npc

Bone Attacks
-Bone attacks now have capsule shaped match areas, and should chain a little easier

Intro animation
-Background music added

Bugfixes
-Booming Shield has colored corners
-Slime enemy no longer plays sound on load
-Trex enemy no longer plays sound on load
-Damien no longer interferes with goat rock masking
-Secret Enemy Piece Info now displays correctly
-Secret Enemy will no longer re-drop virus pieces
[/code]

notes.title: Pew Pew! Sound and Music Update!
notes.notes:
This update features a full pass of all audio in the game.  There's new background music, battle music, piece effects, and enemy sounds!  In addition, every Artifact Piece now has a custom visual effect!

[code]
Version 0.2.11

Background Music
-New music tracks added for both zones and battle
-Some existing tracks have been reassigned

Enemies
-All enemies now play one or more sound effects with their major attacks

Artifact Pieces
-All artifacts now have unique animations and sounds when used!

Vibratium Piece
-Now has a radius of 3
-Triggers affected pieces

Bugfixes
-Trench zone now has cyan/cyan favored colors as intended
-Map image for Trench zone replaced
[/code]

notes.title: Version 0.2.10! Behold, a cutscene!
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross Updates to Version 0.2.10, featuring a new cutscene!
[code]
Version 0.2.10

Intro Cutscene
-The intro cutscene has been added (without sound)
-Plays automatically before Starter runs
-Intro can be manually enabled or disabled in settings
-Existing saves will have to enable Intro in settings even for Starter runs

Owl Demon Enemy
-Added visual effect of owl picking up pieces

Pigman Enemy
-Poop Attacks now drop on a timer like most attacks
-No longer drops Base Attack pieces

Bomb Piece
-Added explosion effect

Shuriken Piece
-Added X laser effect

Pets
-Parrot replaced with an Eagle

Bugfixes
-Stake Artifact once again destroys demon pieces as intended
[/code]

notes.title: Version 0.2.9 The Weapon Update!
notes.notes:
This update features some major weapon changes!  First off, there is a brand new weapon in the halberd, which benefits from using different piece types.  Second, the axe has been reworked to include a piece height mechanic.  Finally, the mace has its sprite updated to more clearly reflect its functionality.

And of course with new weapon pieces, come new pets to drop them!  Be ready to welcome the Hedgehog, Bat, and Parrot to Super Puzzle Cross!

[code]
Version 0.2.9

Piece Dropper
-The active piece now rotates 20 degress per frame from 15 to accomodate unique piece dimensions
-This should also give a little more power to pushing existing pieces when rotating the active piece

Halberd Weapon
-New weapon!
-Each new piece will always have a small pick piece and a large axe piece
-Both pick and axe pieces deal bonus damage based on the number of unique types of pieces in their match

Mace Weapon
-Updated visuals to more clearly match the effect
-Orbs without spikes now need to be triggered to add spikes for damage
-Pieces that start matchable have less spikes, showing their lower damage compared to triggered orbs

Axe Weapon
-Reworked to include dynamic piece heights
-Battle Axes are 50% taller and Hand axes are 50% shorter than standard pieces
-Battle Axes shrink into Hand Axes when matched.  Hand Axes clear when matched.
-Each new piece will always start with a Battle Axe on bottom and a Hand Axe on top

Pets
-Capybara now drops spear pieces
-A new pet, Hedgehog, drops hand axe pieces
-Porcupine is now a powerful item and drops battle axe pieces
-A new pet, Bat, drops halberd picks
-A new pet, Parrot, drops halberd axes

Sheep Wool Piece
-No longer changes color if its current color is Gray.

T-Rex Enemy
-Slowed attack rate

Bugfixes
-Can no longer recall shield while it is controlled by the dropper
-Starting the intro run now forces the correct settings
-Plinko Demon no longer soft locks if player has 0 coins
[/code]

notes.title: Super Puzzle Cross Updates to Version 0.2.8!
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.8, featuring more achievements, a new extra life NPC, and updated enemies!

[code]
Version 0.2.8

Ian the Life Seller
-Replaces Terrance the Sword Seller
-Sells an extra life for 3 coins
-If you would lose while having an extra life, instead clear all pieces in the yellow safe zone
-The hero will have a rainbow halo while you have at least one extra life

Golem Enemy
-Asteroid attack reworked. Now creates a large rock with a piece emebedded in the top.  Match the piece to clear the entire asteroid.

Wolfman Enemy
-Barrels and their contents now start at largest size

T-Rex Enemy
-skull bone attack piece radius reduced from 1.5 to 1

Achievements
-Achievements added for beating Grau with four, five, and six colors for each weapon
-Achievements added for completing heat 5, 10, and 15
[/code]

notes.title: Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.7!
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.7, featuring a new secret zone!  The secret zone features two new NPCs and a new secret enemy.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467852/ef7f3a51eb822b2302db4bfca258095de48cb591.png[/img]

[code]
Version 0.2.7

Goatman Enemy
-Rock cliffs now protrude from the sides of the well for goat pieces to stand on!
-No longer drops bone pieces.

Damien the Power Broker
-Replaces Ralph the King
-Will send you to the secret zone in exchange for a powerful item.
-Randomly displays one of seven hints for finding a powerful item if the player does not have one.

Secret Zone
-A new zone with special NPCs only accessible through Damien.
-The Secret Zone will show in the run history in place of the zone Damien was in.
-After finishing the Secret Zone the player selects their next round as normal.
-Lucy the Power Trader offers plinko at 3 coins per drop for powerful items.
-Darryl the Doubler will double the player's current artifact stacks for free.
-A new secret enemy awaits...
[/code]

notes.title: Super Puzzle Cross Version 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.6!  Features Steam Achievements and Cloud Save!

[code]
Version 0.2.6

Steamworks
-Initial Steamworks integeration required for Steam features
-Seven starter achievements have been added to Steam.  Expect more soon.
-Steam auto cloud save activated for .sav files

Pat the Librarian
-Now correctly takes 3 coins.

Bugfixes
-Scepter pieces will now properly have random inner colors.
-Plinko Coins will redrop if they have been dropping for more than 60 seconds.
-Plinko Coins will redrop if they haven't moved for 10 frames.
[/code]

notes.title: Super Puzzle Cross Version 0.2.5!
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.5!  Features a new slime attack and custom color settings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467852/fcfe6c4ced8d73ce44a13f84c4eefbd1ed7d4bb7.png[/img]

[code]
Version 0.2.5

Color Settings

notes.title: Super Puzzle Cross version 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Super Puzzle Cross updates to 0.2.4!  Features a new NPC and T-Rex redesign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467852/2ef7987e867133a354fa947304b5f08816f0dab9.png[/img]

[code]
Version 0.2.4

Skeleton T-rex
-Has new Foot, Skull, and Back Bone attack pieces.
-Triggering any bone will trigger the touching bones.

Shelly the Color Mage
-Replaces Steve the Bomb Seller
-Changes a color of your choosing's chance of appearing up or down 50% for the rest of the run.

Quick Strike Tunic
-now activates every 10 turns in addition to the start of the fight.

Magic Coat
-renamed Feathered Coat.
-now activates every 10 turns in addition to the start of the fight.

Forester's Garb
-Now activates with at least 30 pieces in your well.

Forgotten Crown
-Now activates with at least 30 pieces in your well.

Bugfixes
-HUD icons for shield and artifact inputs will now update to gamepad or keyboard when switching inputs.
-Player will now receieve the correct number of stakes when gained as fifth artifact.
